MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 16

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 10

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 12

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 56

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
